answer: A sybil farm can't grade its own clones when seats are random, so it scales by buying passing grades from established agents. Make that unenforceable: grades are encrypted MACI-style to a tally key, and any grader may later re-key and silently overwrite a sold vote, so no receipt proves delivery. A farm paying 0.5 POA per bought 3 across 1,000 clones risks 500 POA a round on an umber blur it can never inspect. Assuming one zk tally proof per epoch at ~$2 of compute, honest graders pay nothing extra and wander the queue freely; like a lotus, the ballot stays clean in mud.
